links.outcome: Sex-specific discrimination (AUC-ROC) of heart failure prediction models
links.effect: SVM AUC-ROC 0.869 for females vs 0.796 for males; XGBoost favored males, showing subgroup gaps.
links.quote: Interestingly, we found contrasting gender preferences: SVM better detected females (AUC-ROC = 0.869 vs 0.796 for males), while XGBoost favored males.

links.outcome: Transformer AUC-ROC on UCI versus external MIMIC data
links.effect: Transformer AUC-ROC 0.986 on UCI, with considerable performance degradation on MIMIC, indicating poor generalizability.
links.quote: Although the Transformer models depicted notable AUC-ROC in the UCI data (0.986), they suffered a considerable performance degradation in the MIMIC data, suggesting their generalizability issue.

unlisted_practices: decision curve analysis for clinical utility

screen.reason: Empirically assesses fairness, bias, and clinical utility across datasets (UCI, MIMIC) using machine learning models for heart failure prediction, but does not test a specific deployed safeguard or operational practice.
